fields.finding: Kapton has sourced CO2/O2/H2/N2/He data but not Ar; Ar is set to N2. Mylar has sourced O2 only: other gas ratios are assumed, including N2, and checked in a sensitivity. Outgassing is water-equivalent with a 5 mass% H2 sensitivity, not measured composition.
fields.proposed_next: Measure a full gas spectrum, including noble gases and organics; distinguish pressure from gas mass.
